title: MultiInput
description: Fiori multi input: a text field with tokens, value help and suggestions, plus the SAP token keyboard model.

usage.summary: Collect several values as caller-managed tokens, with suggestions and optional value help.
useWhen: Accept multiple free-form or application-validated entries; create tokens in onCommit and supply them through tokens.
Suggest values with SuggestionItem; set filter when the component should narrow the supplied suggestions.
Remove caller-managed tokens in onTokenDelete, and connect showValueHelpIcon and onValueHelpTrigger to a separate selection surface.

avoidWhen.when: Select only from a predefined option set and let the control manage selected option tokens.
Provide the actual multiattribute search or condition editor; the value-help callback only opens a surface supplied by the caller.
